questions.question: Which spelling correctly turns happy into a noun?
questions.explanation: Correct: happiness changes the final y to i before adding -ness. Transfer: try the same rule with lazy → laziness.

questions.question: Which spelling correctly adds -ful to beauty?
questions.explanation: Correct: beautiful changes beauty's final y to i before -ful. Transfer: plenty becomes plentiful in the same way.

questions.question: Which word correctly adds -ment to excite?
questions.explanation: Correct: excitement keeps the final e before adding -ment. Transfer: use the same pattern in achievement.

questions.question: Which spelling correctly adds -ly to gentle?
questions.explanation: Correct: gently drops the final e before adding -ly. Transfer: simple becomes simply using the same change.

questions.question: Which spelling correctly adds -ing to begin?
questions.explanation: Correct: beginning doubles the final n before -ing. Transfer: forget also doubles its final consonant in forgetting.

questions.question: Which spelling correctly adds -ed to admit?
questions.explanation: Correct: admitted doubles the final t before -ed because the last syllable is stressed. Transfer: permit becomes permitted.

questions.question: Which word correctly changes possible into a negative adjective?
questions.explanation: Correct: impossible uses the prefix im- before a word beginning with p. Transfer: patient becomes impatient.

questions.question: Which spelling correctly adds -ous to danger?
questions.explanation: Correct: dangerous adds -ous without keeping an extra e. Transfer: poison becomes poisonous.

questions.question: Which spelling correctly adds -able to rely?
questions.explanation: Correct: reliable changes the final y to i before -able. Transfer: vary becomes variable.

questions.question: Which spelling correctly adds -ation to imagine?
questions.explanation: Correct: imagination drops the final e before adding -ation. Transfer: prepare becomes preparation.
